architecture.catalog: 20 catalogues, stable IDs, original order, correction overlay only; artist thumbnails optional with offline fallback.
architecture.deck: Ordered setup-local entries {item, category, copyText}; identity is item+category; one visible limit applied both on restore and live add; drag order persists.
architecture.directCopy: Lossless ordered copyText joined with comma+space. This is the deterministic source of truth.
architecture.localComposer: Keep the legacy sentence composer for its eleven recognized categories. If artist, artstyle, genre, template or any future category is selected, fall back to the lossless ordered copy instead of dropping ingredients.
architecture.templates: Template and genre display names are metadata. Their full values are copied once. Never prepend the display name unless the user explicitly edits the final.
architecture.aiVerbalizer: Explicit user action only. Preserve ordered ingredients, at most one in-flight request per setup, reject stale/empty results, and retain the local prompt on error. Missing AI configuration means disabled, not implicit request.
architecture.aiRendering: Render returned text with textContent; no innerHTML adoption. Do not persist provider secrets in setups.
architecture.favorites: Persist item, category and resolved copyText or stable catalog ID so restored favorites never depend on a mutable display lookup.
architecture.random: Random selection is explicit only, never on load/reset; report skipped/full categories and preserve deck order.
architecture.bridge: Canonical destination is BZ Aggregator and creates a draft only. Show historical internal targets only when a matching V6 workshop exists. Never trigger generation.
architecture.persistence: Deck, favorites, custom order and final text are setup-local and survive duplicate/version/export/restore. Reset defaults preserves named personal setups.
architecture.accessibility: Keyboard-operable add/remove/reorder, visible focus, aria-pressed state, searchable categories and non-color status cues.
architecture.build: Movable/renamable bank with stable tool and item IDs. Deck and Backstage remain fixed.
